entries.title: International Google Pixels are different than American models - here's how
entries.summary: In case you were wondering in which country you should buy a Pixel phone, you world traveler you.
entries.excerpt: Google is one of the largest smartphone manufacturers in the world, so it probably shouldn't come as a surprise that Pixel handsets are sold in a number of regions outside the US. However, like all good device makers, Google tweaks its products based on where they are sold in order to conform to local regulations and customer preferences. Different countries have different languages, power sockets and networks, for instance. So for those curious about what's different between Pixels sold here in America and those available abroad, here is a quick rundown of some of the most notable tweaks and changes between US models and their international variants.
